cohort: Twenty-one women at a single center with Cystic Fibrosis (CF) who became pregnant between March 2020 and March 2021.
finding: The center observed a significant increase in pregnancies among women with CF following the approval of elexacaftor/tezacaftor/ivacaftor, and despite the COVID-19 pandemic and pre-existing conditions, they experienced generally uncomplicated pregnancy and delivery courses through a multidisciplinary approach.
mod_finding: Of the 8 live births, 4 (50%) were delivered vaginally and 4 (50%) were delivered by cesarean section.
gest_age: Preterm (including one at 34 weeks), Term, Large for gestational age, Intrauterine growth restriction
